newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-PACEMAN SRINATH PUTS INDIA ON TOP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PACEMAN SRINATH PUTS INDIA ON TOP.

text.p: Javagal Srinath bowled India into command on the third afternoon of the third and final test against South Africa on Saturday.
Paceman Srinath took three for 71 as South Africa reached tea at 221 for five, still 189 runs behind.
The saving grace for the hosts was the amount of successful attacking strokes played by their batsmen as they raced along at more than four an over throughout the first two sessions.
But South Africa lost the dangerous Daryll Cullinan when he hit a powerful pull straight to substitute fielder Pankaj Dharmani at square leg after scoring 33 from 46 balls.
Srinath struck again four overs later when Hansie Cronje top-edged an attempted pull to the wicketkeeper.
Cronje had blazed to 43 from just 57 balls with seven boundaries, but when he was out South Africa were in trouble at 147 for five.

A brilliant sixth wicket stand between Brian McMillan and Shaun Pollock restored South Africa. With McMillan playing the anchor role, Pollock went for his shots and reached 38 not out. His partner was on 29 in a stand of 74.
